def transform(grid):
    n = len({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    residues = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                residues[(c-r) % n] = v
    pattern = [residues[i] for i in range(n)]
    return [[pattern[(c-r) % n] for c in range(len(row))] for r, row in enumerate(grid)]
